title: FlowTwin-Guard architecture and ablation benchmark

execution_tiers.development: Any model/ablation subset or reduced/overridden budget. Results are for pipeline debugging only.
execution_tiers.pilot: All registered variants at the frozen budget on an ID-only D1 dataset, or with fewer than all registered seeds. OOD endpoints are explicitly not applicable when no OOD profiles exist.
execution_tiers.protocol_complete_synthetic: All registered variants and seeds at the exact frozen budget, with both verified test_id and test_ood_profile partitions present. This is not field or external-data confirmation.

research_question: Does causal, uncertainty-aware, route-conditioned P&ID transport improve synthetic HTST fault diagnosis and selective reliability over matched temporal and graph baselines?

dataset_contract.test_access_policy: Each trained checkpoint is calibrated completely on validation_id before the test iterator is opened. Test labels never select epochs, thresholds, temperatures, models, ablations, or hyperparameters.
dataset_contract.ood_applicability_policy: OOD metrics require both ID and held-out-profile test rows. An ID-only pilot records OOD metrics as not_applicable; it never synthesizes or relabels OOD examples.
dataset_contract.counterfactual_policy: Only simulator-declared, time-aligned normal/mode-matched pairs from the same profile, replicate and disturbance group are used.
dataset_contract.oracle_input_policy: fault modifiers, canonical labels, behavior/fault flags, safety outcomes and unsafe volume are targets or evaluation fields only; they are never model inputs

training_budget.training_window_sampler: deterministic event-aware plus timeline-spanning selection using train labels only; every train episode containing a non-N00 target row must retain at least one such row
training_budget.class_balance: shared exhaustive train-only population, each row counted once with eval_mask; inverse-square-root frequency, mean-normalized and clipped to [0.25,4]
training_budget.evaluation_windows: exhaustive; every row exactly once through eval_mask

reference_execution.accelerator_policy: MPS or other accelerator runs are permitted only as exploratory runs and must record the actual device and environment.

calibration.anomaly_threshold: validation-only maximum row F1 with highest-threshold tie break
calibration.conformal_policy: counterfactual-group/observable-mode block-max split conformal on validation_id; empirical synthetic coverage only because validation profiles are not numerous enough for a profile-shift guarantee
calibration.no_conformal_ablation_policy: argmax class and validation-calibrated anomaly threshold only; no prediction-set or abstention claim

primary: combined-test mean horizon-penalized detection latency in seconds (misses receive the remaining observable event horizon)
combined-test false-alarm onsets per negative hour
unsafe forward litres accumulated before first post-effect alarm

aggregation.summary: Profile-level endpoints are computed separately; seed mean and sample standard deviation are secondary reproducibility summaries.
aggregation.comparison: Paired differences against full FlowTwin-Guard use common plant profiles and a deterministic hierarchical profile-cluster bootstrap; technical seeds are resampled within each sampled profile.
aggregation.multiplicity_policy: No plant profiles are treated as independent time rows and seeds are never treated as biological/process replicates. Report all registered variants, effect directions and uncertainty intervals without cherry-picking.

publication_gate.protocol_complete_synthetic: Only a run matching every registered model, ablation, seed and budget field and verified ID/OOD domain metadata receives the protocol_complete_synthetic label.
publication_gate.external_confirmatory: Confirmatory claims additionally require immutable prospective preregistration, a profile-level power justification, a sealed independently generated or external dataset, and preferably real-plant validation; the runner never grants this label automatically.
publication_gate.subset_runs: Any CLI subset or budget override is labelled exploratory in the manifest and must not be presented as the frozen benchmark.
publication_gate.field_validation: Synthetic benchmark results require independent real-plant validation before operational claims.

claim_boundary: Research-only synthetic non-biological HTST benchmark. It does not establish field accuracy, pasteurization efficacy, HACCP conformity, safe-product status, or release authorization.
